description: A plain-weave tube on 4 shafts: the same threading, tie-up and treadling as two layers, woven with one shuttle from the left, on an odd number of ends so the weave continues around both edges.
roles_legend: T = top layer, B = bottom layer, one letter per pick, pick 1 first
pass_directions_legend: one arrow per pick, pick 1 first: ← right to left, → left to right (left and right as the weaver sits at the front of the loom)
turns_legend: one entry per shuttle turn: <pick>-<that shuttle's next pick> <edge where the pass ended> <joins = the next pick is on the other layer, open = the same layer>
matrix_orientation: One string per pick, pick 1 first. Character k is end k + 1, so end 1 is at the LEFT (the editor draws end 1 at the right and shows the mirror image).
interlacement_legend: X = warp over weft (rising shed), . = weft over warp. Every intersection of both layers: this is not the face of the cloth.
